caption: The yellow shared bicycle next to the power box on the right side of the stairs has turned its front wheel to the left.

The blue and white rectangular cushions on the lower bed have appeared. The black blanket at the foot of the lower bed has appeared. The brown stool with four legs, placed to the right of the lower bed against the wall, has appeared. A person wearing a white top and blue pants appears on the gray mattress at the bottom of the bed, facing the wall behind the bed. The word "Rost" in glowing blue letters has appeared on the wall behind the upper and lower beds.
The first row of school desks on the right side has shifted forward.

The red fire extinguisher on the right wall of the classroom is no longer present, and a person wearing a hat, dark jacket, shorts, and yellow shoes has appeared at the door on the right side of the classroom.
The bouquet of blue and purple flowers on the bedside table to the left of the first bed on the right side of the scene has been replaced with a bouquet of blue flowers.
The red car on the rooftop of the green building on the right side of the scene has been replaced by a green sofa.
A person wearing a black jacket, black pants, and white shoes has appeared on the left side of the stairs, holding a camera in their right hand and facing the stairs.
A new blue sign with the word "Cautious" has appeared on the wall above the electric vehicle.
The white ball that was on the right side of the picnic blanket, in front of the blue and white lounge chair, is now visible.

The yellow non-motorized vehicle has turned its front wheel to the right. A man wearing a gray coat, blue pants, and white shoes has appeared on the middle step of the stairs in the distance, with his hands crossed in front of him, facing the yellow non-motorized vehicle.

A person wearing a white long-sleeve shirt, blue pants, and black shoes has appeared on the floor mat at the foot of the bed, with their legs bent and resting against the bed frame, arms wrapped around their legs, and their head lowered. The word "Rest" in glowing blue letters has appeared on the wall behind the lower bed.

The word "Efficient" is no longer visible on the floor, and a woman wearing an orange coat, black leggings, black boots, and a black hat has appeared near the center of the scene, facing away from the camera towards the desks with computers.
